title: Built
description: How the builder ended: built, or stopped with what is missing as a name; and at most three short decisions. The card shows what is missing and each decision as the builder's judgement, never as computed.

outcome.description: The slice is written in its worktree.

decisions.description: At most three decisions the builder made that the owner should know, each one short sentence. The card shows them as the builder's judgement, cut and stripped of control characters.

oneOf.description: The builder stopped, since the slice needs a capability that is not there.

outcome.description: The builder stopped before the slice was done.

decisions.description: At most three decisions the builder made that the owner should know, each one short sentence. The card shows them as the builder's judgement, cut and stripped of control characters.

missing.description: What is missing: where it would live, and its name. No sentence: the card shows the name as the builder's judgement.

lacks.description: Where the missing capability would live.

name.description: The name of the missing function, operation or action, such as worktrees.commit.
